build_apt.reason: The original upstream Maturin bootstrap builds its full CLI and Python PEP517 distribution in the isolated build environment.

complete_runtime_handoff.complete_installed_tokenizers_subset: Requires the separate exact passed PyYAML native wheel/receipt; not claimed by the independent wheel build.

registry_count_scope: Union of complete original Cargo locks, including inactive optional/dev/other-target entries; active native graph is captured separately by cargo metadata.
scope: Preparation-only exact source-built Maturin PEP517 backend and three locked Rust wheels; separate explicit native Tiktoken lock resolution, never production runtime admission.

sources.bootstrap_tag_basis: Unchanged setuptools-rust RustBin sets Distribution.has_ext_modules true; the original platform-specific bdist_wheel uses the real CPython interpreter/ABI tags. This stricter source-built wheel is never retagged to the py3-none tags of Maturin's own PyPI frontend.

expected_bootstrap_metadata_basis.reason: The unchanged official Setuptools bootstrap emits the original project declarations. Uploaded sdist PKG-INFO was normalized by the Maturin frontend (python_full_version); preserve both originals and require the authored project declarations for this source build.
